segments.title: Anchor Personal Disclosure: Hair Bleaching and Relationship Status
segments.notes: Case Blackwell opens broadcast discussing plans to bleach hair blonde following a breakup; technical audio issues delay start.

segments.title: Surreal Indie Game Playthrough: Queer Man Peering into a Rock
segments.notes: Case Blackwell and guest Fiona Nova play through a surreal psychological horror game exploring dementia, memory fragmentation, and queer romance; game reveals connections to Tsai Ming-liang film 'The Hole'.

segments.title: Viral Video Review: Heels, Walruses, and Street Brawls
segments.notes: Case and Fiona review viewer-submitted internet clips including high-heel sprinting, walrus encounters, and a beachside altercation.

segments.title: Anchor Breakup Deliberation: Cheeks vs. Reflection
segments.notes: Case Blackwell conducts live audience poll on post-breakup action; chat deadlocks at 50/50 before 'cheeks' wins 51%.

segments.title: Broadcast Conclusion
segments.notes: Case and Fiona sign off; Case references potential return to 'bender era' depending on relationship outcome.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors the broadcast alongside guest Fiona Nova; discloses personal breakup and conducts live poll on post-breakup behavior.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: recurring interruption. Briefly interrupts early broadcast with freestyle hype over game launch; later obscures game animation during hype train event.

lore_notes.fact: Case Blackwell discloses he is going through a breakup and plans to bleach his hair blonde tomorrow.
Case Blackwell references his 'bender era during G4' where he would work hungover after all-night benders.
Case Blackwell conducts live chat poll 'cheeks or reflection' to decide post-breakup action; 'cheeks' wins 51% at [01:36:34].

episode_summary: Barely Informed News airs a special co-hosted broadcast with guest Fiona Nova, featuring a full playthrough of the surreal indie title 'Queer Man Peering into a Rock' — a fragmented narrative exploring dementia, lost love, and cinematic references to Tsai Ming-liang's 'The Hole.' The broadcast transitions into an Amongst the Web viral video review before concluding with anchor Case Blackwell soliciting live audience guidance on his personal breakup via a deadlocked 'cheeks versus reflection' poll.
